title: Mathematics in the age of AI (arXiv 2608.16753)
author: Terence Tao

metaphors.title: Foundations under stress test
metaphors.paraphrase: Like the 1900–1930 crisis in foundations, but now the implicit framework of values and practices is being stress-tested.

metaphors.title: Proof scarcity and abundance
metaphors.paraphrase: Institutions built for scarce proofs will misbehave in an era of proof abundance.

metaphors.title: Proof indigestion
metaphors.paraphrase: Impedance mismatches, or less flatteringly proof indigestion, all along the pipeline from generation to canonicalization.

metaphors.title: Friction sanded away
metaphors.paraphrase: Over-polished AI proofs sand away the natural friction that tells a reader where to slow down.
